inputs.text:
This is another attempt to turn a party disagreement into a morality play about “entrenched wealth.” Gas companies keep energy flowing, and property investment is part of how families build security; treating them as villains is not serious reform. Angus Taylor was right to resist a rush to change course just to satisfy critics.

On Iran, refusing to give a glib endorsement of war is prudence, not weakness. The public deserves leaders who put Australia’s interests first and think carefully before committing to military force—not politicians pressured into repeating someone else’s criticism of Donald Trump.
